description: A structured screen of an SME on turnover, EBITDA. use it rather than `verify_business_screen` for business eligibility, not business screen; an object with 7 fields including detail, error. $2.5 USDC.

ebitda_eur.description: Annual EBITDA in EUR. REQUIRED. Undisclosed is NOT zero — an undisclosed figure returns insufficient_data, never a model.
ebitda_eur.title: Ebitda Eur

employees.description: Headcount. Optional; reported in the echoed input block.
employees.title: Employees

exit_multiple.description: The exit EV/EBITDA multiple. Optional; the house base case of 4.0x is applied and the default is named in coverage_gaps.
exit_multiple.title: Exit Multiple

location.description: The location, free text, e.g. 'Lisboa'. Echoed back in the response; it is the caller's own input, not pipeline data.
location.title: Location

notes.description: Free text. Used only for the Rule B food-service check. It is NOT stored, NOT logged and NOT returned.
notes.title: Notes

price_eur.description: The asking price in EUR. REQUIRED.
price_eur.title: Price Eur

sector.description: The sector, free text, e.g. 'Business services — accounting & tax advisory'. Used for Rule B (food service) and for the benchmark bucket. Matching is word-boundary and accent-insensitive.
sector.title: Sector

seller_financing_pct.description: Seller financing offered, as a percentage of price. The house approach is 20-30%, so 20 or more is reported as 'preferred' and less as 'absent'.
seller_financing_pct.title: Seller Financing Pct

structure.description: The capital structure. 'house' is the ONLY supported structure in v1. Anything else is NAMED in coverage_gaps — it is never silently modelled as something it is not.
structure.title: Structure

name: assess_business_eligibility

error.description: The machine-readable error code, when the operation failed.

note.description: A note on how the answer was produced.

title: Assess Business Eligibility
